Denver Rescue Mission denies most homeless women use of restroom
An advocate with Housekeys Action Network Denver, or HAND, was denied use of the restroom at Denver Rescue Mission's Lawrence Street location this week for being female. Terese Howard recorded and posted her experience on Instagram. In the recording, she approached the check-in window at the Mission and said, “Hi, I just need to use the restroom.”

Denver children sleeping on cardboard outdoors, speaker tells council
Speaking through an interpreter, Arturo Gerder made an impassioned plea in Spanish Monday during the Denver City Council public comment period to get children off the streets. He said 300 families are living on the streets, a number echoed by Housekeys Action Network Denver, or HAND. HAND obtained the statistic from city staff. Staff said more than 300 people are on a waiting list for shelter.
